I ported the LRU cache simulator to Rust using only the standard library, and `node check.mjs` passes all 5 example cases.

I also compared it against the original Clojure program on two generated inputs of 1,000,000 commands each and on a file of malformed lines. The output matched byte for byte in every case. Each 1,000,000-command input took about 0.1 s. The unit tests pass and `cargo clippy` reports no warnings.

- **Code:** `src/cache.rs` holds the cache itself, where every operation takes
